description: This file declares a utility class 'nmUtils' within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, providing static methods for network device properties, interface status, hostname management, and security configurations related to NetworkManager, primarily for Linux-based systems. It includes necessary dependencies and defines some configuration constants.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for network interface management and configuration related to NetworkManager.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Retrieves device properties related to network interfaces.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts signal quality percentage to signal strength metric.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi security mode from access point information.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Returns Wi-Fi frequency based on access point data.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Provides a string description of security mode based on flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets NetworkManager logging level to trace for debugging.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes marker files indicating interface disablement states.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: writePersistentHostname
methods.description: Writes the hostname to a persistent file.

methods.name: readPersistentHostname
methods.description: Reads the persistent hostname from storage.

calls: setMarkerFile(const char* filename, bool unmark = false)
